entries.580546298b316628: A business that manufactures and sells various building materials such as noncombustible building materials, designs and carries out construction work, and designs and carries out steel-frame fireproof coating work. Its main products are the calcium silicate board "Hairakku Funen®", the interior noncombustible decorative board series "Sutendo®" and "Adekku®", the "FG® Board" that allows curved-surface installation, and the concrete-look interior board "BEoNA® (Beona)". Manufacturing is carried out by the Company and by its subsidiaries A&A Ibaraki Co., Ltd. and A&A Osaka Co., Ltd. (building materials), Uniboard Co., Ltd. (low-pressure melamine decorative boards) and Decor Co., Ltd. (interior building materials and decorative sheets). The design and execution of construction work, including steel-frame fireproof coating work, is carried out by the subsidiary A&A Crest Co., Ltd., and some raw materials such as cement are purchased from Taiheiyo Cement Corporation, an other affiliated company. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales of the whole business, combining material sales and construction work, were ¥23,067 million (up 23.4% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥2,253 million (down 8.1% from the previous fiscal year). Exports to China, Taiwan and South Korea fell below the previous year in sales volume owing to stagnation in the local construction markets, but sales increased owing to price revisions in response to various cost increases, expanded sales of high-value-added products, and the acquisition of DIC Decor Co., Ltd. (now Decor Co., Ltd.) as a subsidiary.
entries.5a05e5a508e707e9: A business that sells various industrial materials and equipment such as noncombustible textile products, marine materials, soundproofing materials and expansion joints; manufactures and sells industrial friction materials, sealing materials, thermal and cold insulation materials, and automotive friction materials and sealing materials; and designs and carries out thermal insulation, cold insulation, air conditioning, heat insulation, soundproofing and fireproofing work. Manufacturing of industrial friction materials, sealing materials and thermal and cold insulation materials is carried out by the subsidiaries Ask Technica Co., Ltd. and Asahi Keisan Kogyo Co., Ltd. Automotive friction materials and sealing materials are manufactured and sold by Ask Technica Co., Ltd. (overseas, manufactured and sold by its subsidiary Ask Technica Indonesia), while noncombustible textile products, marine materials, soundproofing materials, expansion joints and others are purchased and sold by the Company. The design and execution of construction work is carried out by the subsidiaries Ask Sanshin Engineering Co., Ltd. and Ask Okinawa Co., Ltd. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales of the whole business, combining material sales and construction work, were ¥22,575 million (down 8.5% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥1,323 million (down 6.4% from the previous fiscal year). In marine-related products, shipments of heat insulation materials and auxiliary materials for car carriers were strong; however, in thermal insulation and furnace construction, sales of the insulation material "Resepal® HS" for aluminum melting equipment fell owing to the global decline in aluminum demand, and automotive-related products were also weak owing to U.S. export tariffs and intensified competition in the Chinese market.

entries.d93b878ca9e3b228: The company has two pillars, the Construction and Building Materials Business and the Industrial Products and Engineering Business, and in both, the company or its consolidated subsidiaries both manufacture and sell materials (materials sales) and design and perform construction work (construction). In the Construction and Building Materials Business, the company manufactures and sells non-combustible building materials, including calcium silicate board 'Hairakku Funen®' and the 'Sutendo®' and 'Adekku®' series of interior non-combustible decorative boards, and its consolidated subsidiary A&A Crest Co., Ltd. is responsible for the design and construction of steel frame fireproof coating work. In the Industrial Products and Engineering Business, the company manufactures and sells industrial friction and sealing materials, thermal insulation materials, automotive friction and sealing materials and marine materials, and its consolidated subsidiaries also carry out the design and construction of thermal insulation, cold insulation, air conditioning, heat insulation, soundproofing and fireproofing work. Part of raw materials such as cement is purchased from Taiheiyo Cement Corporation, an other affiliated company.
